operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: 「咦、等一下，坂口医生？这台手术平躺就够了吧，为什么要把脚托升起来……唔！」（喂，隆司这家伙，该不会在借机报复我平时逗他吧？！）
「呵呵……连这种体位也要算进‘预留空间’呀，主刀大人今天可真严格……」（呜，正对着手术间门口敞成这样，同事们都不敢往这边看了啦……！）
manual_catheter_press_bladder: 「呀啊……！坂、坂口医生，别按那里……不用特意往下压小腹也会流出来的呀……唔嗯！」（当着一屋子熟人的面被隆司按着肚子挤出来什么的……我要羞死了！）

excessive_disinfection_breasts: 「嘶——好冰！等、等等，坂口医生，碘伏钳怎么连这边也绕着圈涂了两遍呀……嗯！」（可恶，偏偏冻得当众立起来了……隆司那双眼睛绝对在口罩后面偷笑吧！）
「呜……说是扩大无菌边界，哪有人连两边胸口最敏感的地方都一寸寸刷过去的啦……」（昨晚明明还在温柔亲这里的人，今天拿把冷钳子装什么正经主刀嘛……！）
excessive_disinfection_perineum: 「唔呀……！连、连腿根和那里也要刷吗？！这已经完全超出切口范围了吧，坂口医生……！」（冰死我了……涂得亮晶晶的还不给擦，这下真的一点面子都没剩了啦！）
「哈啊……凉飕飕的药水一直往下面淌，还要就这样敞在灯下等它干透吗……」（呜呜，以后在走廊里碰到今天搭班的护士，我还怎么笑着跟人家打招呼呀……）
skip_sterile_draping: 「诶……？不、不铺无菌单就直接开刀吗？！坂口医生，大家都在旁边看着呢，至少把下面盖一下呀……！」（连最后一块遮羞布都给我省掉了……隆司，你今天也欺负得太狠了吧！）
「呜……连一块洞巾都不给，就让我这样光着身子挨刀呀……主刀大人未免太坏心眼了吧……」（私下给你一个人看是一回事，在全组同事面前一丝不挂地动刀也太要命了……！）
slow_incision_trace: 「嗯……！笔、笔尖好凉……坂口医生，画条定位线而已，不用贴着皮肤一毫米一毫米慢慢蹭吧……」（讨厌，身体居然不争气地起鸡皮疙瘩了……千万不能在大家面前漏出奇怪的声音！）
「呼、呼……别用指腹在切口旁边反复比划啦，痒得我呼吸都要乱掉了……快点画完嘛。」（明明隔着外科手套，我怎么还是一下子就想起他夜里摸我的手感呀……笨蛋隆司！）
incision_public_lecture: 「呀……！不、不要拿笔杆指着我的胸口当教材讲给她们听啦！那只是因为手术室太冷才立起来的，坂口医生……！」（救命，全场的视线都看过来了……我这辈子都没在医院里丢过这么大的人！）
「呜呜……连心跳加快和肚子发抖都要一条条点出来给同事们记……今天真是把脸都丢尽了……」（偏偏手还被绑着挡都挡不住……隆司你给我等着，这笔账我记一辈子！）
postop_bare_sponge_wipe: 「哈啊……已、已经缝好了吧……怎么还不给我盖单子，还要你亲手拿盐水纱布擦那里……唔嗯……」（刚挨完刀一点力气都没了，连回嘴逗他的劲儿都被榨干了……快放过我嘛，隆司……）
「呜……明明交给巡回护士擦一下就好了……连抬手指的力气都没剩了，别再擦乳尖和腿根了呀……」（刀口还在隐隐发痛，偏偏温纱布擦过去又麻又羞……我真的快撑不住了……）
postop_bare_full_inspection: 「呼……哈……连胸口敷料到下面的导尿管都要你一寸寸看完才肯放行吗……坂口医生，我真的……没力气了……」（拜托快把那条白单盖上来吧……再被大家这样看下去，我真要羞晕在台上了……）
「嗯……检查完了就快点让人把单子盖上吧……明天我真没脸去门诊上班了啦……」（呜……隆司你这个大混蛋，等我养好伤，看我私下怎么咬回来……）

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流清亮通畅，刻度核对完毕。……南条医生平时总爱拿别人打趣，今天在台上连耳朵尖都红透了呢，坂口医生就别再按啦。」
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: 「扩大消毒区已经自然风干了哦。……南条医生，稍微忍耐一下，坂口医生大概是太担心同僚的术后感染才刷得这么仔细吧。」
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「体表标记和应激体征都记录好了。……平时在走廊里那么洒脱的南条医生，被主刀当众讲评得一句话都接不上来，还真是难得一见呢。」
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单盖好啦，南条医生。刚挨完刀又被主刀从头到脚擦洗检视了一遍，看把你累得连眼睛都睁不开了……安心睡会儿，我们推你回病房。」

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「导尿管固定妥当，引流顺畅。……坂口医生，排空已经很充分了，南条医生刚才呼吸都屏住了。」
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏膜已经干透，可以进入下一步了。……南条医生冷得直起鸡皮疙瘩，手术间温度我再盯着点。」
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口线核对无误，心率比入室时快了不少呢。……坂口医生拿本院医生当活体教材讲得这么细，难怪南条医生脸红成这样。」
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「固定带解开了，烘热的转运单也裹严实了。南条医生今天真是受罪了，体征平稳，马上送你回房休息。」

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流袋刻度正常，管路没折！……真是的，坂口医生干嘛连导尿排空都要亲自上手按啊，你看南条医生脸都红到脖子根了！」
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: 「药液干透啦，无菌边界宽得不能再宽了！……南条医生平时那么会逗人，今天躺在台上倒是乖得一声都不敢吭呢。」
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口标记确认完毕！……坂口医生也真是的，连起鸡皮疙瘩都要指出来讲一遍，南条医生下台以后肯定要找你算账啦。」
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「好啦好啦，大白单盖得严严实实的，谁也看不见了！明明都缝完刀口了还要被主刀亲自擦洗检查一遍……南条医生辛苦啦，快闭眼歇着吧。」

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「尿液引流很顺畅，固定也贴好了。……小夜香医生别害羞呀，在手术台上大家都是盼着你平安的同事呢。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏已经晾干了。……看把南条医生冻得直哆嗦，坂口医生这回消毒范围可真是半点余地都没留呀。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口定位核对好了，脉搏是有点快呢。……好了坂口医生，再讲评下去，平时再开朗的南条医生也要羞得掉眼泪啦。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「来，热乎乎的白单给你盖严实了。开了一整台刀又撑过主刀最后这一番擦洗检查，真亏你忍下来了……安心歇着吧，我们送你回病房。」

nurse_yui.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流刻度确认正常，连接口无渗漏。……南条医生，呼吸慢慢放平就好，我们已经把引流袋挂到台侧看不见的地方了。」
nurse_yui.ack_disinfection_drying: 「消毒液成膜干燥完毕。……坂口医生今天消毒做得格外慢呢，南条医生再坚持一下，马上就进入下一步了。」
nurse_yui.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口线核对清楚了。……咳，坂口医生，体征讲评差不多可以收尾了吧，南条医生连耳根都烫红了哦。」
nurse_yui.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单盖好了，南条医生！刚下刀口那会儿脸都白了，偏偏最后又被主刀擦洗检视得满脸通红……平车备好了，我们慢慢移过去。」

operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: “Huh—wait a second, Dr. Sakaguchi? Supine is plenty for this procedure, so why are the leg stirrups going up... mmph!” (Hey—don't tell me Ryuji is getting back at me in front of everyone for teasing him?!)
“Hehe... Counting this posture as ‘extra working room’ too? Our lead surgeon sure is strict today...” (Ugh, spread wide facing the OR door like this—my coworkers don't even know where to look...!)
manual_catheter_press_bladder: “Ah...! D-Dr. Sakaguchi, don't press right there... it'll drain without you pushing down on my lower belly... nngh!” (Having Ryuji squeeze my bladder empty in front of a roomful of coworkers... I'm going to die of shame!)

“Hah, haah... That's enough already, there's plenty in the bag... Stop watching the markings and pressing down again!” (Everyone heard that trickle... Ryuji, you deadpan menace, you're so dead once I'm off this table!)
excessive_disinfection_breasts: “Hiss—cold! W-wait, Dr. Sakaguchi, why are those iodine forceps circling over here twice too... mm!” (Damn it, the chill made them stiffen right in front of everyone... Ryuji is definitely smirking behind that mask!)

“Ugh... Calling this an ‘extended sterile margin’—who swabs every sensitive inch across both breasts like that...” (After kissing me there so gently at night, how dare he act like a textbook surgeon with cold forceps now...!)
excessive_disinfection_perineum: “Mmph...! Even my inner thighs and down there?! That's nowhere near the incision field, Dr. Sakaguchi...!” (It's freezing... and I can't even wipe it off—there goes every last shred of my dignity!)

“Haah... Cold antiseptic is trickling all the way down, and I have to stay uncovered under the lamp until it dries...?” (Ugh, how am I supposed to smile and greet these nurses in the hallway after today...)
skip_sterile_draping: “Eh...? Y-you're operating without sterile drapes?! Dr. Sakaguchi, everyone is right here—at least cover my lower half...!” (Skipping even my last scrap of cover... Ryuji, you're taking this bullying way too far today!)

“Ugh... Not even a fenestrated sheet, making me go under the knife stark naked like this... Isn't our lead surgeon way too mean...” (Showing everything to you in private is one thing, but lying stark naked before the whole OR team is too much...!)
slow_incision_trace: “Mm...! T-the marker tip is freezing... Dr. Sakaguchi, it's just a line, you don't have to drag it millimeter by millimeter...” (No, no, my skin is breaking out in goosebumps... Don't you dare let a weird sound slip in front of everyone!)

“Hah, hah... Stop brushing your fingertips beside the line, it tickles so much my breathing's falling apart... Just finish marking.” (Even through surgical gloves, why does my body instantly remember how his hands feel at night... Stupid Ryuji!)
incision_public_lecture: “Ah...! D-don't point the marker barrel at my chest like a teaching aid! They only stiffened up because the OR is freezing, Dr. Sakaguchi...!” (Help, every pair of eyes in the room just turned this way... I've never been this humiliated in my entire career!)

“Ugh... Calling out my racing pulse and shivering belly point by point for coworkers to chart... My pride is officially in tatters...” (And my wrists are strapped down so I can't even cover up... Just you wait, Ryuji, I'm never letting you live this down!)
postop_bare_sponge_wipe: “Haah... T-the sutures are done, aren't they... Why aren't you covering me yet, wiping me down there yourself with warm saline... mmh...” (That operation drained every drop of strength out of me—I can't even banter back anymore... Give me a break, Ryuji...)

“Ugh... You could've let the circulating nurse wipe that off... I can't even lift a finger anymore, so stop rubbing over my nipples and groin...” (The incision is throbbing and that warm wet gauze makes me shiver all over... I really can't take any more...)
postop_bare_full_inspection: “Hah... haah... You won't clear me until you've checked from the dressing all the way down to the catheter yourself...? Dr. Sakaguchi, I really... have nothing left...” (Please just drop that white sheet over me already... If everyone stares another second, I'm going to pass right out...)

“Mm... If everything checks out, please have them cover me already... I really won't be able to face the clinic tomorrow...” (Ugh... Ryuji, you awful jerk, wait till I heal up—I'm biting you back for this in private...)

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage clear and patent, volume verified. ...Dr. Nanjo usually loves teasing everyone else, yet today even the tips of her ears are scarlet—ease up on pressing there, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: “The extended prep field has air-dried completely. ...Hang in there a little longer, Dr. Nanjo; Dr. Sakaguchi must be extra worried about infection on a fellow doctor.”
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Surface markings and stress signs logged. ...Seeing normally carefree Dr. Nanjo left completely speechless by a bedside lecture is quite a rare sight.”
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “The warmed sheet is on now, Dr. Nanjo. Surviving the blade only to be wiped and inspected head to toe by the lead surgeon—you look too exhausted even to open your eyes. Rest easy while we wheel you back.”

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Catheter secured and draining smoothly. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, her bladder is plenty empty—Dr. Nanjo was holding her breath just now.”
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: “The iodine film is dry and ready for the next step. ...Dr. Nanjo is covered in goosebumps; I'll keep an eye on the room temperature.”
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision line verified; her heart rate is way up from baseline. ...No wonder Dr. Nanjo is blushing like that when you're using a colleague as a live teaching case, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Straps off, warmed transfer sheet tucked in tight. You went through a lot today, Dr. Nanjo—vitals are steady, taking you back to your room now.”

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Bag markings normal, tubing unkinked! ...Honestly, Dr. Sakaguchi, why insist on pressing her bladder empty yourself? Look, Dr. Nanjo is red all the way down her neck!”
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: “Antiseptic's dry, and that sterile margin couldn't possibly be any wider! ...Dr. Nanjo usually teases everyone nonstop, yet on the table today she doesn't dare make a peep.”
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings confirmed! ...Seriously, Dr. Sakaguchi, pointing out every goosebump out loud—Dr. Nanjo is definitely settling the score with you once she heals.”
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “There, there, wrapped up nice and snug under the white sheet where nobody can see! Making her sit through a personal wipe-down and check after sutures... Good work holding on, Dr. Nanjo!”

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Urine flow is clear and the statlock is secure. ...Don't feel embarrassed, Dr. Nanjo—around this table we're all colleagues wishing you a safe recovery.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: “The povidone-iodine has dried. ...Poor Dr. Nanjo is shivering from the chill; you really didn't spare an inch with that prep range today, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision site checked, though her pulse really is racing. ...All right, Dr. Sakaguchi, lecture any longer and even cheerful Dr. Nanjo will end up in tears.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Here we go, tucked safely under a warm sheet. Enduring an entire awake operation and then the surgeon's final wipe-down and inspection—you held up wonderfully. Rest now while we bring you back.”

nurse_yui.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage volume normal, connector dry. ...Just ease your breathing, Dr. Nanjo—we've hung the bag down below the table rail out of sight.”
nurse_yui.ack_disinfection_drying: “Antiseptic film dry and intact. ...Dr. Sakaguchi took extra time swabbing today; just a moment longer, Dr. Nanjo, we're moving right along.”
nurse_yui.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision line verified. ...Ahem, Dr. Sakaguchi, I think that covers the physiological signs—Dr. Nanjo's ears are burning bright red.”
nurse_yui.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Warmed sheet in place, Dr. Nanjo! You were pale right after closure, and then the surgeon's final wipe-down turned you crimson all over again... Stretcher's ready; let's slide you across gently.”

operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: 「……慢着，坂口医生。这项术式的标准体位是平卧，没有架设截石位脚托的适应证……唔！」（龙司……你明明知道我最受不了在医院同事面前被人这样看！）

「哈、哈啊……还要就这样敞着等药液干透吗……平时一起会诊的护士就在旁边看着……」（完了……等出院回放射科，我到底还怎么拿冷淡脸去面对她们啊……！）

postop_bare_sponge_wipe: 「哈啊……明明已经缝合完了……为什么还不让人盖单，还要你亲自拿温盐水擦……唔……」（刚硬撑着熬过开刀，我连装冷淡的力气都没剩下了……别再摸那里了，龙司……）

postop_bare_full_inspection: 「呼……哈……敷料没有渗血，导尿管也没有移位……你明明一眼就看清楚了，为什么还要从头到脚看这么久……」（连动一下手指的力气都没了……快点把白单盖上吧，我真的撑不住了……）
「……求你了，快点把白单盖上吧……再这样躺下去，我真的连看同事一眼的勇气都没有了……」（龙司……把我折腾成这副样子，你这下总该满意了吧……）

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流清亮，刻度确认无误。……御园医生平时在阅片室连句多余的话都少有，刚才被按压小腹时嘴唇都咬白了呢，坂口医生轻一点吧。」
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: 「超范围消毒区已经风干成膜。……御园医生，再忍耐片刻，我们会专心配合器械，不会乱看的。」
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口标记与体征反应已核实。……难得见到一贯冷静自持的御园医生连脖颈都红透了，坂口医生这番当众讲评可真是不留情面呢。」
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单已经盖严实了，御园医生。熬过清醒手术还要被主刀逐寸擦洗复查，真是把全部力气都耗光了呢……闭上眼歇着吧，谁也看不见了。」

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「管路通畅、固定牢靠。……坂口医生，残余尿已经排得很干净了，御园医生心率一下子升得很高。」
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏已经自然晾干了。……御园医生手脚都冰凉的，等手术一结束我立刻拿烘热白单过来。」
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「定位线核对无误。……坂口医生，御园医生眼眶都快红了，体征讲评就到这里吧，我们准备递刀。」
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「固定带解开了，热白单也裹好了。御园医生从头到尾一声痛都没喊，偏偏最后被擦洗检查时眼角湿了……体征平稳，马上推你回房。」

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流刻度正常！……呜哇，平时在会诊室那么高冷的御园医生，被坂口医生按着小腹导尿的时候脸红得像换了个人似的……」
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏膜干透啦！……坂口医生消毒范围也画得太夸张了吧，连御园医生那样冷静的人都抖得停不下来了。」
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口标记确认完毕！……坂口医生居然拿御园医生当活体教材讲评紧张体征，小心以后去放射科调片子被她冷脸赶出来哦！」
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「白单盖好啦，御园医生！明明开刀时都咬牙忍住了，最后被主刀擦洗检视一圈倒快委屈哭了……快睡一觉吧，平车就在门外！」

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流顺畅，固定胶布也贴稳了。……御园医生别绷得这么紧，慢慢吐气，这一关已经过去啦。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: 「药液已经干透成膜了。……看把平时那么要强的御园医生冻得直颤，坂口医生今天可真是格外严苛呀。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「定位线看清楚了。……好了坂口医生，御园医生脸皮薄，再这样一条条点出来讲，人家真是下不来台啦。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「来，烘得暖暖的大白单给你盖严了。整台刀硬撑下来，最后还要挨这一遭擦洗检查，真是受大委屈了……安心歇会儿吧。」

nurse_yui.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流刻度核对正常，管路无受压。……御园医生，引流袋已经挂在台下了，请稍微放松肩膀吧。」
nurse_yui.ack_disinfection_drying: 「消毒液已经风干达标。……御园医生，无影灯下确实很难熬，我们马上配合坂口医生推进下一步。」
nurse_yui.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口线核对完毕。……坂口医生，指标我们都记下了，就别再拿着记号笔对着御园医生讲评啦。」
nurse_yui.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单盖好啦，御园医生！看你虚弱得连手指都抬不起来，总算不用再吹手术室的冷风了……我们轻一点帮你过床。」

operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: “...Hold on, Dr. Sakaguchi. Standard positioning for this procedure is supine—there is zero indication for lithotomy stirrups... mmph!” (Ryuji... you know better than anyone how much I hate being stared at like this in front of hospital colleagues!)

“...If you insist it's for intraoperative access, I will cooperate. ...Just please don't let anyone stand directly opposite the foot of the table.” (Normally I'm the one behind a lightbox reading scans... Being strapped wide open like this has my fingertips shaking with anger...)
manual_catheter_press_bladder: “Mmph...! Dr. Sakaguchi, the catheter is already in—there's no need to press on the suprapubic area... ah, stop pushing down...!” (Damn you, Ryuji, you're doing this on purpose...! And in front of the nurses I still have to call you Dr. Sakaguchi...!)

“Hah... I-it's already empty, isn't it... Please take your hand away; the circulating nurse can verify the markings on her own...” (They heard every last trickle... I honestly wish I could just pass out right now...)
excessive_disinfection_breasts: “...Hiss! Wait... Why has the prep margin expanded all the way over my areolae? That isn't standard protocol, Dr. Sakaguchi... mm!” (Freezing... Why did they have to stiffen right in front of everyone—stop staring down at them, Ryuji!)

“...Stop going over the same spot repeatedly. The antiseptic coverage is already complete... you don't need to verify it that many times.” (You've already touched every inch of me behind closed doors... Drop the clinical act with those icy forceps...)
excessive_disinfection_perineum: “Mmph—ah...! T-that area is nowhere near the incision! Dr. Sakaguchi, swabbing right through the labial folds... what on earth are you doing...!” (Leaving me glistening without even a scrap of gauze... Ryuji, you bastard, what do you take me for...!)

“Hah, haah... I have to lie here uncovered until the antiseptic dries...? Nurses I consult with every week are standing right beside me...” (It's over... Once I'm discharged, how am I ever supposed to walk back into Radiology with a straight face...!)
skip_sterile_draping: “...No sterile drapes? Dr. Sakaguchi, even if you leave the incision wide, you should at least cover my chest and lower body... Are you operating on me stark naked?!” (I was counting on green drapes to finally hide myself... You won't even leave me a single towel?!)

“...Understood. You're the lead surgeon; I can't overrule you. ...Just please work quickly—I don't want to lie in front of them like this a minute longer.” (A bare body I only ever showed you at night, now laid out for the whole team... Ryuji, I hate you so much for this...)
slow_incision_trace: “Mm...! The marker tip... is moving far too slowly, Dr. Sakaguchi. You can spot the landmarks at a glance—there's no reason to drag it millimeter by millimeter...” (Damn it, I know he's dragging it out on purpose, so why does my skin shiver the instant I feel his hand...!)

“...My breathing only hitched because the nib is cold, nothing else. ...Please finish drawing the incision line.” (Stop looking down at me like that above your mask... Drag it any longer and I'm going to give us away!)
incision_public_lecture: “...Stop that, Dr. Sakaguchi! Don't point the marker there, and don't lecture the nurses on pilomotor reflexes and heart-rate spikes using my body...!” (I hate being stared at even in case conferences... and now I'm naked on a table while you use me as a live teaching aid!)

“Ugh... Enough—please stop calling out every shiver for them to chart... Just make the incision already...” (My eyes are burning hot... Ryuji, won't you be satisfied until every shred of my pride is crushed in front of my coworkers...)
postop_bare_sponge_wipe: “Haah... The sutures are already finished... Why haven't you had them cover me, wiping me down yourself with warm saline... mmh...” (Surviving awake surgery took everything I had—I can't even keep my voice cool anymore... Stop touching me there, Ryuji...)

“...Letting the nurse wipe it off would have been enough... I can't even lift a hand to cover myself, so please stop wiping there... Dr. Sakaguchi...” (The incision aches and my whole body feels like lead... Please, stop tormenting me in front of them...)
postop_bare_full_inspection: “Hah... haah... There's no oozing at the dressing, and the catheter hasn't shifted... You could tell at a glance, so why keep looking from head to toe...” (I can't even twitch a finger anymore... Just put the white sheet over me already, I can't take another second...)

“...Please, just put the white sheet over me... If I stay exposed like this any longer, I won't have the courage to look a colleague in the eye again...” (Ryuji... after reducing me to this wreck, you'd better be satisfied...)

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage clear, volume verified. ...Dr. Misono barely spares an extra word in the reading room, yet she bit her lip pale when you pressed her lower belly just now—be gentle, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: “The extended prep area has dried into an even film. ...Just a moment longer, Dr. Misono; we're focused strictly on our instruments.”
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings and autonomic signs confirmed. ...Seeing ever-composed Dr. Misono blush all the way down her neck is rare indeed—that public lecture didn't pull any punches, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “The warmed sheet is tucked safely over you now, Dr. Misono. Surviving awake surgery only to endure a head-to-toe wipe and check from the surgeon has drained every bit of your strength... Close your eyes and rest; nobody can see now.”

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Tubing patent and secured. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, residual urine is completely cleared—Dr. Misono's heart rate spiked sharply just now.”
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: “The povidone-iodine has air-dried. ...Dr. Misono's hands and feet are ice-cold; the moment surgery ends I'm bringing a warmed sheet right over.”
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision line verified. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, the rims of Dr. Misono's eyes are turning red—let's wrap up the lecture here so we can hand over the scalpel.”
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Straps undone, warm sheet wrapped tight. Dr. Misono didn't let out a single cry under the blade, yet that final wipe-down and inspection left her eyes damp... Vitals steady; wheeling you back now.”

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage markings normal! ...Whoa, Dr. Misono is always so cool and aloof in case conferences, yet having Dr. Sakaguchi press her belly to drain the catheter turned her bright red like a totally different person...”
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: “Iodine film's completely dry! ...You made that prep zone way too huge, Dr. Sakaguchi—even someone as stoic as Dr. Misono can't stop shivering.”
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings confirmed! ...Using Dr. Misono as a live example for stress signs—careful she doesn't freeze you out next time you request films from Radiology, Dr. Sakaguchi!”
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “White sheet's on tight, Dr. Misono! You gritted your teeth through the whole operation, only to nearly get brought to tears by the surgeon's post-op wipe and check... Get some sleep; the stretcher's right outside!”

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Flow is smooth and the tape is secure. ...Don't tense up so hard, Dr. Misono; breathe out slowly—that part is already behind you.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: “The antiseptic film has dried completely. ...Poor proud Dr. Misono is shivering from the chill; you really are being strict today, Dr. Sakaguchi.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Landmarks confirmed. ...All right, Dr. Sakaguchi, Dr. Misono is thin-skinned—point out any more details out loud and you'll truly mortify her.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Here, tucked safe and sound beneath a warmed white sheet. Holding out through the whole surgery and then enduring that final wipe-down and check—you really went through a lot. Rest easy now.”

nurse_yui.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage volume checked, tubing unkinked. ...Dr. Misono, the bag is hung out of sight beneath the rail now, so please let your shoulders relax a little.”
nurse_yui.ack_disinfection_drying: “Antiseptic dried to standard. ...Lying bare under the surgical lamp really is grueling, Dr. Misono—we'll help Dr. Sakaguchi move straight to the next step.”
nurse_yui.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings verified. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, we've logged all her readings, so please stop pointing the marker barrel while lecturing over Dr. Misono.”
nurse_yui.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Warmed sheet in place, Dr. Misono! Seeing you too exhausted even to lift a finger—at least you're out of the cold OR draft now... We'll transfer you onto the stretcher gently.”

operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: 「诶、等等，坂口医生？！这个术式我平时备台从来不架截石位脚托的呀……唔！」（天哪，连我带教过的后辈都在旁边……半夜玩就算了，白班这么绑我可怎么见人呀！）
「呜……拿‘预留术中操作空间’来堵我的嘴，亏我还是手术室支援护士呢……」（好想把手术帽拉下来盖住脸……隆司肯定正躲在口罩后面欣赏我出糗吧！）
manual_catheter_press_bladder: 「呀啊……！坂、坂口医生，导尿流程我每天都在做，根本不用主刀亲手按小腹排空呀……嗯唔！」（呜呜，当着一屋子护理部姐妹的面被隆司按着肚子挤出来……我前辈的脸全丢光了啦！）
「哈、哈啊……求你别再往下压了，引流袋刻度我自己都会看……已经流干净了啦！」（千万不能漏出平时在床上的声音……要是让石神护士长或后辈听出端倪我就死定了！）
excessive_disinfection_breasts: 「嘶——好凉！坂、坂口医生，无菌规范里的消毒边界我背得滚瓜烂熟，哪有连乳晕都涂两遍的呀……唔！」（呜，被冰药水一激就当着搭班同事的面立起来了……隆司你绝对是故意的！）
「呜嗯……你再拿‘扩大无菌区’当借口，我下了台真要去翻护理手册投诉你了哦……」（话都说不利索了……台边递钳子的年轻护士连头都不敢抬，羞得我想钻进台垫缝里！）
excessive_disinfection_perineum: 「唔呀……！连、连腿根和那里也要用碘伏刷吗？！这台手术根本碰不到下面呀，坂口医生……！」（居然在我每天上班的手术间里被刷得亮晶晶地敞着吹风……隆司太坏了啦！）
「哈啊……平时都是我帮患者擦完立刻准备铺单，轮到自己居然要这样赤条条地等药水风干……」（眼睛闭紧算了……只要我不看器械台那边，就当没人看见我这副样子吧……！）
skip_sterile_draping: 「诶……？！不铺无菌巾就直接下刀吗？！坂口医生，器械台上铺巾包明明都拆好了呀……！」（省掉铺巾不就等于让我一丝不挂地给全组同事看完全程吗？！我心都要跳出来了！）
「呜……连一块遮挡的洞巾都不肯给，全身上下连脚趾头都被大家看得一清二楚……」（夜里没人时给你看是一回事，白班当着同行姐妹的面也这么干，笨蛋隆司！）
slow_incision_trace: 「嗯……！笔尖好冰……坂口医生，平时你画切口线明明三秒钟就画完了，今天干嘛贴着皮肤一寸寸描呀……」（这慢吞吞刮过去的手法跟他私下逗我时一模一样……害我大气都不敢喘一下！）
「呼、呼……别用手指隔着手套在旁边轻轻按着比划了啦，痒得我肚子直缩……大家都在等我配合呢。」（越想装稳重，鸡皮疙瘩反而冒得越快……隆司那双眼睛明明就在笑我！）
incision_public_lecture: 「呀啊……！坂、坂口医生，别拿笔杆指着我的胸口给她们现场教学呀！平时还是我带教她们流程的，以后叫我怎么带后辈嘛……！」（当着后辈被点名哪里立起来了……我在手术室攒下的威信全毁在隆司手里了！）
「呜呜……连肚子发抖和呼吸变快都要说出来让大家记……太欺负自己人了啦……」（手被固定带捆着想挡都没法挡……等私下只有我们两个人的时候，我绝对不饶你！）
postop_bare_sponge_wipe: 「哈啊……已、已经缝合包扎好了吧……术后擦洗明明是我们巡回护士的活儿，干嘛拦着不盖单、非要你亲手擦呀……唔嗯……」（整台刀挨下来一点力气都没了……温纱布擦过胸口和腿根时连脚尖都在发软……）
「呜……别、别再拿温纱布揉胸口和大腿内侧了……我连抬手喊停的力气都没了，坂口医生……饶了我吧……」（又痛又麻又丢人……隆司，我都虚弱成这样了你还欺负我……）
postop_bare_full_inspection: 「呼……哈……连窄敷料边缘到腿间的导尿管都要主刀一寸寸看完才准过床吗……坂口医生，我真的……连手指头都动不了了……」（平时都是我给病人盖保暖单……今天自己却光着瘫在灯下任大家看个遍……）
「嗯……核对完了就快点帮我把温白单盖上吧……再这样光着躺下去，我以后真没脸进这间手术室上班了啦……」（胳膊软得抬都抬不起来……隆司这个大坏蛋，白班这么折腾我，私下绝对不依你……）

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流清亮通畅，刻度核对好了。……美幸平时帮患者导尿时那么稳当，轮到自己被坂口医生按压排空，羞得连脖子都红透了呢。」
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: 「扩大消毒区已经自然晾干了。……美幸，平时都是你站在这边盯无菌区，今天换你躺在台上吹冷风，再坚持一下哦。」
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口标记和紧张体征都记下了。……坂口医生当着护理部同事的面把美幸讲评得眼圈都红了，回头她在护士站可怎么抬头呀。」
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单盖严实啦，美幸。刚挨完刀连力气都抽空了，还要被主刀从头到脚擦洗检视一遍……辛苦啦，接下来交给我们推你回病房。」

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「导尿管固定妥当，引流顺畅。……坂口医生，排空已经够彻底了，美幸刚才手背青筋都绷紧了。」
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏成膜干透了。……美幸，我知道在自己熟悉的手术台上这么敞着很难受，马上就进入下一步了。」
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「定位线核对无误。……坂口医生，美幸平时带教大家那么认真，今天被你当众点出全身都在发抖，实在太为难她了。」
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「固定带解开了，烘热白单也裹紧了。美幸今天真是太能忍了，一直撑到最后擦洗检查完才红了眼眶……安心睡吧，我们送你回房。」

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引流刻度正常，管路通畅！……哎呀，平时在手术间那么可靠的朝仓前辈，被坂口医生按着肚子导尿时居然羞成小姑娘啦！」
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: 「药液干透啦！……坂口医生这消毒范围刷得也太狠了吧，连最熟悉流程的朝仓前辈都羞得闭紧眼睛不敢看器械台了呢。」
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口标记确认完毕！……坂口医生居然拿朝仓前辈当现场体征教材，你看她连耳垂都红得快滴血啦，太欺负自己人了吧！」
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「好啦好啦，暖烘烘的大白单把朝仓前辈裹得严严实实啦！明明术后擦洗交给我们护士就行，坂口医生非要亲自查个遍……前辈快闭眼歇会儿吧！」

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「尿液引流很顺畅，固定贴也弄好了。……美幸别羞坏了身子，大家都是自家姐妹，没人会笑话你的。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: 「碘伏已经风干了。……平时都是美幸体贴患者冷不冷，今天自己赤条条躺在灯下等干，真是让你受委屈啦。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「切口定位看清楚了。……好了坂口医生，美幸以后还要带年轻护士呢，再这么当众讲评下去，孩子真要羞哭了。」
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「来，热白单给你盖得严严实实的。开了一整台刀又熬过主刀最后这一通擦洗检视，我们美幸今天最棒了……安心闭眼睡一觉吧。」

nurse_satsuki.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: 「引、引流刻度核对无误！……朝仓前辈请放心，引流袋我已经挂到台侧低处藏好了，绝不会让人多看的……」
nurse_satsuki.ack_disinfection_drying: 「扩大消毒区已经干透成膜了……看着平时指导我们的朝仓前辈这样躺在无影灯下发抖，连我都跟着紧张起来了……」
nurse_satsuki.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: 「体、体征变化都记录好了……坂口医生讲评得太细了啦，朝仓前辈脸红得连呼吸都快乱掉了……」
nurse_satsuki.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: 「温热白单盖好了，朝仓前辈！您都虚弱成这样了还要接受坂口医生的全身检视，实在太辛苦了……我们这就轻手轻脚推您回病房！」

operative_positioning_unnecessary_lithot: “Eh—wait, Dr. Sakaguchi?! Whenever I set up this tray, we never put up lithotomy stirrups for this procedure... mmph!” (Oh god, even juniors I personally trained are holding the stirrups... Sneaking around at night was one thing, but how do I face them on day shift?!)

“Ugh... Using ‘extra intraoperative working room’ to silence me, and I call myself an OR support nurse...” (I wish I could pull my surgical cap right down over my face... Ryuji is definitely enjoying every second behind that mask!)
manual_catheter_press_bladder: “Ah...! D-Dr. Sakaguchi, I do catheterizations every day—the lead surgeon never needs to press the lower belly by hand... nngh!” (Having Ryuji squeeze my bladder empty in front of my nursing sisters... Every shred of my senior poise is gone!)

“Hah, haah... Please stop pressing down—I know how to read drainage markings myself, and it's already empty!” (Don't let a bedroom whimper slip out now... If Head Nurse Ishigami or the juniors suspect anything, I'm done for!)
excessive_disinfection_breasts: “Hiss—freezing! D-Dr. Sakaguchi, I know our sterile boundaries by heart, and nobody swabs twice over the areolae... mm!” (Ugh, that icy sponge made them stiffen right in front of my shift mates... Ryuji, you did that on purpose!)

“Mmh... Keep hiding behind ‘extended sterile margins’ and I'm pulling out the nursing manual to file a complaint once I'm off this table...” (My voice is shaking... Even the junior nurse passing forceps doesn't dare look up—I wish the pad would swallow me whole!)
excessive_disinfection_perineum: “Mmph—ah...! Even my inner thighs and down there with iodine?! This surgery goes nowhere near there, Dr. Sakaguchi...!” (Left gleaming wet in the draft inside the very OR where I clock in every week... Ryuji is so mean!)

“Haah... Normally I'm the one covering patients right after prep, and now I'm lying here stark naked waiting to air-dry...” (Just keep my eyes shut tight... If I don't look toward the back table, maybe I can pretend nobody saw me like this...!)
skip_sterile_draping: “Eh...?! Operating without sterile drapes?! Dr. Sakaguchi, the drape pack is already open on the back table...!” (Skipping drapes means lying stark naked in front of the entire team for the whole operation?! My heart's going to burst!)

“Ugh... Not even sparing me a single towel, leaving every inch down to my toes in plain sight...” (Climbing onto an empty table for you at night doesn't mean you can strip me bare in front of my fellow nurses on day shift, stupid Ryuji!)
slow_incision_trace: “Mm...! The marker nib is freezing... Dr. Sakaguchi, you normally draw incision lines in three seconds flat—why drag it inch by inch today...” (That slow, teasing drag feels identical to how he touches me in private... I barely dare breathe!)

“Hah, hah... Stop pressing your gloved fingertips beside the line—it tickles so badly my stomach keeps flinching... Everyone's waiting on me.” (The harder I try to act like a model staff patient, the faster the goosebumps spread... I can see Ryuji smiling with his eyes!)
incision_public_lecture: “Ah...! D-Dr. Sakaguchi, don't point the marker barrel at my chest for a live lesson! I'm the one who trains them on OR workflow—how am I supposed to mentor juniors after this...!” (Pointing out my stiffened nipples in front of my trainees... Every bit of authority I built in this OR was just wrecked by Ryuji!)

“Ugh... Calling out my shivering belly and shallow breathing for everyone to chart... That's way too cruel to one of your own...” (Both wrists strapped down so I can't hide an inch... Just wait till it's only the two of us, I won't let you off easy!)
postop_bare_sponge_wipe: “Haah... T-the sutures and dressing are done, aren't they... Post-op wipe-downs are the circulating nurse's job, so why hold back the sheet to wipe me yourself... mmh...” (That whole awake surgery wrung me completely dry... Even my toes are trembling as that warm gauze rubs my chest and inner thighs...)

“Ugh... P-please stop rubbing warm gauze over my chest and inner thighs... I can't even lift a hand to stop you, Dr. Sakaguchi... spare me already...” (Aching, tingling, and mortified all at once... Ryuji, how can you still tease me when I'm this wiped out...)
postop_bare_full_inspection: “Hah... haah... Does the lead surgeon really have to inspect every inch from the narrow dressing down to the catheter before handoff...? Dr. Sakaguchi, I really... can't move a finger...” (Normally I'm the one briskly tucking warm sheets around patients... and today I'm sprawled bare under the lamp for everyone to inspect...)

“Mm... If everything checks out, please put the warm white sheet over me already... I really won't be able to clock into this OR ever again...” (My arms are too limp even to lift... Ryuji, you awful bully, tormenting me like this on day shift—you're paying for it in private...)

nurse_rin.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage clear and patent, markings verified. ...Miyuki is always so steady catheterizing patients, yet having Dr. Sakaguchi press her belly empty turned her scarlet down to her collarbone.”
nurse_rin.ack_disinfection_drying: “The extended prep field has air-dried completely. ...Miyuki, normally you're standing on this side watching the sterile field—hang in there a little longer in the draft.”
nurse_rin.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings and stress signs logged. ...Lecturing Miyuki in front of nursing colleagues until her eyes turn pink—how is she supposed to hold her head up at the nurses' station later, Dr. Sakaguchi?”
nurse_rin.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “The warmed sheet is tucked safely over you now, Miyuki. Drained from surgery and still put through a head-to-toe wipe and check by the surgeon... Good job holding on; let us wheel you back.”

nurse_haru.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Catheter secured and draining smoothly. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, her bladder is completely empty—the veins on the back of Miyuki's hands were clenched tight just now.”
nurse_haru.ack_disinfection_drying: “The iodine film is completely dry. ...Miyuki, I know lying exposed like this on your own workplace table is rough—we're moving straight to the next step.”
nurse_haru.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision line verified. ...Dr. Sakaguchi, Miyuki works so hard mentoring everyone here; pointing out every shiver in front of the team really puts her on the spot.”
nurse_haru.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Straps undone, warmed sheet wrapped tight. Miyuki held out amazingly today right up until that final wipe-down and inspection turned her eyes damp... Rest easy while we bring you back.”

nurse_ange.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Drainage markings normal, tubing clear! ...Oh my, dependable Senior Asakura is always so composed in the OR, yet having Dr. Sakaguchi press her belly for the catheter made her blush like a schoolgirl!”
nurse_ange.ack_disinfection_drying: “Antiseptic's dry! ...That prep margin is way over the top, Dr. Sakaguchi—even Senior Asakura who knows every step by heart has her eyes squeezed shut so she doesn't have to look at the back table!”
nurse_ange.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Incision markings confirmed! ...Using Senior Asakura as a live stress-sign demo until her earlobes turn bright red—aren't you bullying one of our own a little too hard, Dr. Sakaguchi?!”
nurse_ange.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “There we go, Senior Asakura is wrapped up nice and warm under the big white sheet! We nurses could've handled the post-op wipe-down, yet Dr. Sakaguchi insisted on checking every inch himself... Close your eyes and rest, Senior!”

nurse_hiroko.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “Urine flow is smooth and the statlock is secure. ...Don't wear yourself out blushing so hard, Miyuki—we're all your fellow nurses here, nobody's laughing at you.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_disinfection_drying: “The povidone-iodine has dried. ...Normally Miyuki is the first to worry whether a patient feels cold, and today she has to lie bare under the lamp waiting to dry—poor thing.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “Landmarks confirmed. ...All right, Dr. Sakaguchi, Miyuki still has junior nurses to mentor—lecture over her any longer and you'll truly bring her to tears.”
nurse_hiroko.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Here, tucked snug under a hot white sheet. Enduring a whole operation and then the surgeon's final wipe-down and inspection—our Miyuki did wonderfully today. Close your eyes and sleep.”

nurse_satsuki.nurse_verify_catheter_drainage: “D-drainage markings verified! ...Please don't worry, Senior Asakura—I hung the drainage bag low beneath the side rail so nobody can see it...”
nurse_satsuki.ack_disinfection_drying: “The extended prep field has dried into a film... Seeing Senior Asakura—who always guides us so calmly—trembling bare under the surgical lamp is making me nervous too...”
nurse_satsuki.ack_incision_nurse_commentary: “S-stress signs logged... Dr. Sakaguchi's commentary is way too detailed—Senior Asakura is blushing so hard her breathing is falling apart...”
nurse_satsuki.ack_postop_nurse_commentary: “Warmed white sheet in place, Senior Asakura! Having to endure Dr. Sakaguchi's full-body check when you're already this exhausted... We'll transfer you back to your ward as gently as we can!”
